title: 第390章 再回青云第389章 金羽再鸣
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
李擎苍走到女儿面前，伸了几次手，最后只敢轻轻扶住她的肩。
“回来就好。”
他说了四个字，声音已经发哑。
李清雪离开青云时还是城主府最锋利、也最让他担心的那把剑。
两年没有消息，外界甚至传过她已经死在天都。
李擎苍不敢追问林天，也不敢让赵灵儿为了私事暴露听风楼的暗线，只能等。
如今人终于站在面前。
哪怕气息虚弱，至少活着。
李清雪没有哭。
她只是站在那里，让李擎苍确认自己的脉搏和体温。
李擎苍一连问了几遍伤势，直到枯荣说人已经真正醒来，只需慢慢恢复，他肩上的力气才松下来。
城主府没有为此点灯庆祝。
知道李清雪归来的只有李擎苍、赵灵儿和几名最可靠的暗卫。
外界仍以为城主府大小姐在外修行，这个旧说法还能替她挡住一部分圣神宫视线。
赵灵儿没有打扰父女重逢。
她走到林天面前，看了看他的白发，又看了看右眼尚未退尽的血痕。
“三个月前回来救云裳，连一封信都没给朕留。”
“当时不能留。”
“现在能了？”
“现在需要你帮忙。”

赵灵儿冷笑：“你每次回来，第一句话都是有事。”
话虽如此，她还是带众人进入城主府密室。
林家那边没有摆宴，也没有敲锣。
林战、林墨、林莹和几名真正知道林天身份的族人已经在密室中等候。
林战看见林天，先用拐杖敲了他一下。
不重。
“还知道回来？”
林天没有躲，跪下行礼。
“让家主担心了。”
“少来这套。”
林战把他拉起来，上下看了一遍，确认胳膊腿都在，才转身招呼李清雪。
林家并没有衰败。
院落比王朝战争前扩建了数倍，药堂、阵阁和护卫堂各自运转。
赵灵儿登基后没有让林家独占大乾，却确实给了足够保护。
林战仍管家族根本，林墨负责外务，林莹管阵法和年轻族人。
林墨把家族这两年的账册交给林天。
林家新收的产业、皇室拨下的战后补偿、丹尊府收益以及年轻族人名单，一项不少。
林战没有因为林天的名声无限扩张家族，反而定下三条家规：不强占普通人的田地，不以林天名义压地方官，不插手皇室继承。
“赵灵儿照顾林家，是她念旧，也是林家在战争中出过力。”
林战道，“若咱们自己把根扎歪了，她今天能扶，明天也该砍。”

林天听完，没有提出改动。
这才是一个经历大战后仍能站住的家族，不是只靠主角留下几瓶丹药便永远安全。
content_en:
Li Qingcang walked up to his daughter, stretched out his hand several times, and finally only dared to gently hold her shoulders.
"Just come back."
He said four words and his voice became hoarse.
When Li Qingxue left Qingyun, it was still the sharpest sword in the City Lord's Mansion and the one that worried him the most.
There has been no news for two years, and there are even rumors that she has died in Tiandu.
Li Qingcang didn't dare to question Lin Tian, ​​nor did he dare to let Zhao Ling'er expose Tingfeng Tower's secret information for private matters, so he could only wait.
Now people finally stand in front of me.
Even if the breath is weak, at least he is alive.
Li Qingxue did not cry.
She just stood there and let Li Qingcang confirm her pulse and body temperature.
Li Qingcang asked about the injury several times. It wasn't until Kurong said that the person had truly woken up and that he only needed to recover slowly that the strength on his shoulders relaxed.
The city lord's palace did not light up lights to celebrate.
The only people who knew about Li Qingxue's return were Li Qingcang, Zhao Linger and a few of the most reliable secret guards.
The outside world still thinks that the eldest lady of the City Lord's Mansion is practicing outside. This old belief can also block part of her view of the Holy Palace.
Zhao Linger did not disturb the father-daughter reunion.
She walked up to Lin Tian, ​​looked at his white hair, and then looked at the blood stain on his right eye that had not receded yet.
"I came back to rescue Yunshang three months ago, but didn't even leave a letter for me."
"I couldn't stay at that time."
"Is it possible now?"
"I need your help now."
Zhao Ling'er sneered: "Every time you come back, the first thing you say is that there is something wrong."
Even so, she still led everyone into the secret room of the City Lord's Mansion.
There was no banquet at the Lin family's side, and no gong was played.
Lin Zhan, Lin Mo, Lin Ying and several tribesmen who really knew Lin Tian's identity were already waiting in the secret room.
When Lin Zhan saw Lin Tian, ​​he hit him with his crutch first.
Not heavy.
"You still know about coming back?"
Lin Tian did not hide, but knelt down and saluted.
"The head of the family is worried."
"Stop doing this."
Lin Zhan pulled him up and looked up and down to make sure his arms and legs were there before turning to greet Li Qingxue.
The Lin family has not declined.
The courtyard has been expanded several times compared to before the Dynasty War, and the Medicine Hall, Formation Pavilion and Guard Hall operate independently.
After Zhao Ling'er ascended the throne, he did not let the Lin family monopolize the power, but he did give him enough protection.
Lin Zhan is still in charge of the family's foundation, Lin Mo is in charge of external affairs, and Lin Ying is in charge of the formation and young clan members.
Lin Mo handed Lin Tian the family's account books for the past two years.
The newly acquired property of the Lin family, the post-war compensation allocated by the royal family, the income of Danzun Mansion, and the list of young clan members are all numerous.
Lin Zhan did not expand the family indefinitely because of Lin Tian's reputation. Instead, he set three family rules: not to occupy ordinary people's fields, not to pressure local officials in Lin Tian's name, and not to interfere in the royal succession.
"Zhao Ling'er took care of the Lin family because she was nostalgic for the past, and it was also because the Lin family contributed in the war."
Lin Zhan said, "If we plant the roots crookedly, she can hold them up today, but she should cut them down tomorrow."
After hearing this, Lin Tian did not propose any changes.
This is a family that can still stand still after a war. It is not just relying on the protagonist to leave a few bottles of elixirs to ensure eternal safety.
